_readme: Every string the app displays lives in this file. Edit the values; leave the keys alone.
Braces {like this} are replaced at runtime. Keep every placeholder that appears in a
string — you may move it within the sentence, but removing one leaves a gap.
The `units` section holds counted nouns. English only distinguishes one/other; Arabic
also has zero/two/few/many. Write {n} wherever the numeral should appear.
After editing run: npm test — it checks that both locale files agree on keys and
footer: Prayer times computed locally from your city. Check-in is verified against your own city's window — never a shared clock.

landing.subtitle: Make a group, invite your friends or family, and build a streak nobody wants to be the first to break.

features.title: The window is the point
features.body: You can only log between the adhan and sunrise, computed for your city and today's date. Not before. Not after.

features.title: Earlier beats later
features.body: The window splits into thirds. Praying right after the adhan is worth 3 points; scraping in before sunrise is worth 1.

features.title: One miss won't end you
features.body: Two grace days a month protect your streak. They score nothing — they just stop a single miss from wiping out 40 days.

landing.scoringNote: Praying in congregation adds +2. Your group ranks by points this week, this month, and all time — plus a shared streak for days when everyone makes it.
landing.honest: Nothing here can prove you prayed — that stays between you and Allah. What it can do is make sure you were awake, and that your friends will notice if you weren't.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: No password. We email you a link that signs you in.
login.sentTo: We sent a sign-in link to {email}
login.sentStep: Open the message and tap the link — you'll land back here, signed in.
login.sentJunk: Can't find it? Look in your Junk / Spam folder. That's usually where it is.
login.sentPatience: It can take a minute to arrive. There's no need to request another link.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Fajr
onboarding.subtitle: Before you can log your first Fajr we need two things: a name your group will recognise, and the city you pray in.
onboarding.why: Your city is what we compute the adhan and sunrise from each day — and that window is the only time a check-in is accepted. That is why this step cannot be skipped.
onboarding.changeLater: We won't ask again. You can change any of it later in settings.

picker.nameHelp: This is what your group sees on the leaderboard.
picker.whereHelp: Fajr and sunrise are computed from this, for every day of the year.
picker.geoUnsupported: This browser can't share your location. Pick a city instead.
picker.geoBlocked: Location was blocked. Pick a city from the list instead.
picker.previewNote: Check-in is open only between these two times.

checkIn.heading: Today's Fajr
checkIn.beforeHelp: Check-in unlocks at the adhan ({fajr}) and closes at sunrise.
checkIn.loggedClosed: The window closed at {sunrise}. Come back tomorrow.
checkIn.graceBody: Your streak is protected. It doesn't count as a prayer — tomorrow does.
checkIn.closedBody: The sun rose at {sunrise}. Today's window has closed.
checkIn.unavailable: Fajr and sunrise could not be resolved for your location today. Try picking a nearer city in

grace.title: You missed {date}
grace.withStreak: A grace day keeps your streak of {days} alive. It scores zero points and never counts as a prayer — it only stops one miss from resetting you to nothing.
grace.withoutStreak: A grace day covers the gap so a fresh streak can build through it. It scores zero points and never counts as a prayer.
grace.remaining: {n} of 2 left this month · resets on the 1st

badges.heading: Badges
badges.empty: None yet. The first one lands after your first Fajr.

dashboard.noGroups: No groups yet. Create one and share the invite link, or enter a code you were sent.

groupForms.addMore: Create another group or join with a code

group.perfectBanner: 🔥 Every member has made it {days} running. Don't be the one who ends it.
group.emptyPeriod: Nothing logged in this period yet.
group.inviteHelp: Anyone with this link can join. Share it in the family group chat.
group.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Every member loses the group and its history. Their personal streaks are unaffected.

join.explain: Joining means your Fajr check-ins show on this group's board. You can only log between the adhan and sunrise in your own city — and you can leave any time.
join.badBody: The code may have been mistyped, or the group was deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Moving city? Update this and every future window follows the new location.
settings.permanence: Past check-ins are permanent — they can't be edited or deleted, by you or anyone else. That's what makes the leaderboard worth anything. You get 2 grace days a month and nothing more.
